diagnosis: The administrative session inspection endpoint queries the connect-pg-simple session table directly by session ID without confirming whether the target session belongs to a customer who has granted active support access or whether the staff member has elevated tenant auditing privileges. Any low-privilege internal staff member can dump full deserialized session objects (including OAuth access tokens, user profiles, internal roles, and CSRF secrets) of any enterprise user.

GET /api/admin/sessions/sess_prod_exec_corp_9941a8b2/inspect HTTP/1.1
